mapper.insert: INSERT INTO Book_Review (review_id, book_id, member_id, content, rating) VALUES (review_seq.NEXTVAL, #{book_id}, #{member_id}, #{content}, #{rating})
mapper.select: SELECT r.review_id, r.book_id, r.member_id, r.content, r.rating, r.created_at, m.name AS member_name FROM Book_Review r LEFT JOIN Member m ON r.member_id = m.member_id WHERE r.book_id = #{book_id} ORDER BY r.review_id DESC
